request.spec: Somewhere on the sheet show me the "leader", which is the name of the person who is rank 1.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for this implementation's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Somewhere on the sheet show me the "leader", which is the name of the person who is rank 1.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet now shows a "Leader:" line, just above the people table, with the name of the person ranked 1. The `bin/e2e` test passes: with Ann, Cy and Di seeded, it shows "Cy".

The server already works out each person's rank, so this was a front-end-only change in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. The leader is simply the person whose rank is 1, so it updates whenever the list reloads after an edit. The stored data and the server are unchanged.

When nobody on the sheet is ranked (an empty sheet, or no one has a momentum yet), the leader shows "n/a", the same placeholder the rank column uses.
